balls.text: Miscues it to long-off and that leaves SRH with 207 to win
Full outside off, driven out to long-off
Looks to go across and play the scoop to a very wide full toss. Miscues it and it lands between the keeper and short fine

Swapnil swipes across the line at a slower bouncer going across him. Doesn't connect. And he reviews for the wide for height. He was jumping in the air when trying to play that and the ball went past his helmet an the umpire decides even if his feet were grounded, it wouldn't have gone above head height
Sliced fine on the off side and that's 10 runs off the first two balls! Full outside off, he opens his face and gets it over short third
Low full toss and Swapnil pummels it over midwicket! What a start for Swapnil!
Slower short ball outside off, pulled away to deep square for a single

Hooked to Nitish Kumar Reddy running in from deep square leg and DK perishes. Cummins takes the pace off again as he goes short. It was an offcutter, angling into Karthik, who looked to help it along, but it goes high in the air and not nearly far enough
Slower bouncer outside off, Dinesh Karthik lets it go over him as it gets called wide for height
Full outside off and DK pummels it along the ground past mid-on for the third boundary of the over
Overpitched outside off and Green drives it back over the bowler, but it goes to long-off on the bounce
Cummins now takes the pace off and goes short, but Green is up to the challenge yet again. Stands tall and slaps it over extra cover
Cummins nails the yorker but Green nails his response to it as well! Backs away leg side and jams his bat down with the full face to punch it right back past the bowler
Flat-batted over extra cover! Length ball outside off, DK skips out to make room and slaps it over the infield. His first boundary today
Another yorker, around middle and off, Karthik flicks it away in front of square on the leg side
Just short of the yorker length around middle and of, Green chips it down the ground to long-on on the bounce
Wide yorker, but just outside the line
Back of length on middle and leg, going across Green, who stretches out and slaps it aerially in front of cover. Good fielding by Nitish Kumar Reddy to run across from deep point to stop that
Full down leg, DK misses his flick and it goes off his front pad through fine leg
Yorker on the stumps and Green digs it out to deep midwicket
Slower ball, full and wide, driven out to long-off
Slower bouncer and Green muscles a pull through midwicket and gets another boundary. The ball sat up nicely and Green picked his spot between deep midwicket and deep square leg
Taps a full delivery through point to get of the mark with a single

Cummins holds on at deep midwicket! Three-for for Jaydev Unadkat! Full and wide, Lomror goes back and across and swings it across the line. Cummins was backtracking and sticks his hands up and grabs it while falling backward
Full and wide, just outside the tramlines. He will have to rebowl that
On a length just outside off, pulled away to long-on
Length ball played out to deep point and they squeeze in a tight second
creative and very neatly done! Waited and waited before the short ball arrived and helped it up and over to beat third man.
works it to long-on
pulled and pulled imperiously to split the gap at deep backward square leg. Once again he's expecting this to be dug into the pitch and is ready when the ball arrives. Incredible timing.
right into the blockhole, dug out to long-on
flayed to long-off
pulled in front of square and he has finally picked the gap! Cummins went short and Green was ready for it.
drilled down to long-on

all that pressure to break free has consumed Kohli! He was looking increasingly edgy in the last few overs to break free, and has perished trying to pick another slower short of length ball that Unadkat did well to bowl well outside off and have him fetch it from far. RCB's innings on decelerate mode.
clobbers the pull but hits it straight to deep midwicket
slower ball but ends up slipping it down leg, Green misses as he attempts to pick it up and over the infield.
taps it into the off side for a single
swing and a miss. Kohli was looking to heave this over deep midwicket
punched to long-off
this one hardly comes up as Shahbaz bowls length on off, Kohli nearly plays on
punched to long-on
flat-batted, one bounce to long-off
swing and a miss. Looked to heave this from outside off, but went at that too early.
pushed through quicker outside off, punched to deep point
slaps this to wide long-off as Kohli gets to his half-century, off 37 balls.
slower length ball on middle and leg, worked to deep midwicket
lofted down the ground to long-on
lives by the sword, dies by it! Unadkat serves up a full toss into Patidar's hitting arc, he flicks this superbly but ends up picking the lone man in the leg side boundary, at deep square leg.
sashays down the pitch and punches this length ball to long-off

two half-centuries in two innings for the man they call RaPa! Nudges this gently to midwicket and gets to the landmark off just 19 balls. It has helped RCB overcome those twin strikes, has taken much pressure off Kohli.
turns this gently towards the man coming in from deep midwicket, looks for a second but is sent back
slower bouncer on middle and leg, Kohli helps this down to fine leg. Good stop by T Natarajan
works this slower delivery down to long-on
pulls this slower delivery on a length to deep midwicket
full on middle and leg, worked down to long-on
flays this on the up to long-off
slower length ball outside off, slapped to deep point
nudges it into the leg side gently for a single.

the best of the lot!  Markande tosss it up but bowls way outside off, Patidar goes after him and ends up lofting him over extra cover. Would've been called wide had he left it, but the gentle toss up was too much of an invitation for him to miss out.
make this three in a row!  Patidar picks this length delivery from outside off and muscles this pull to clear deep midwicket comfortably.

goes straighter and just clears Markram at long-on! Markande bravely tossed it up again, Patidar muscled it straight and hard and ended up clobbering this. Markram thought he had a chance of leaping high to try and push the ball back, but eluded him
right into the slot and Patidar lofts him through the line to clear long-off!  He makes even brutal hitting look beautiful
slips in a googly but starts from way outside off and called wide
driven with the spin to wide long-off
whips this from outside off to deep midwicket
slaps this into the gap at wide long-off, Markram covers good ground before he puts in a dive to cut that off
gets a leading edge, but that's safe! Goes to short third on the bounce, they scamper a single thanks to the misfield
predictable stuff from Unadkat and Patidar takes full toll. Held his shape as he picked this from outside off and walloped it one bounce to the deep midwicket fence.
slower length ball on off, dabbed to short third for a single
slower bouncer into the body from around the stumps, pulled to deep midwicket
Length ball holds in the surface, but Patidar is able to punch it away to long-off
Tossed up outside off, Kohli looks to sweep it away but gets it off the underedge and through to deep midwicket
On a length around middle and off, he taps it through midwicket for a single
Full on the stumps, tucked to deep backward square
Clipped out to long-on
And counter the spin, Patidar does! This is right in the arc outside off and Patidar hits it long and high straight down the ground
Shahbaz gets a straight one to beat Kohli's defence as he lunges forward. Goes off the pads to short third. Muted appeal from Shahbaz
Miscues the pull, but it lands short of deep midwicket. This was a length ball outside off and he tried to swipe across the line but got it off the inside half
Slapped over the bowler's head! This was darted in quick and full, Patidar makes room and hammers it down the ground
On a length outside off, punched to cover's left
Full on off, pushed out to long-off
On a length on off, Kohli goes back and punches it down to long-on

Oh, beauty! Made Will Jacks look like an amateur! That was tossed up real slow. Tossed up outside off. Jacks got down and was through the sweep very early. But the lack of pace on the ball means he misses it completely and the ball crashes into off stump
Length ball on off punched out to long-off
Wrong'un on a length on off, punched down to long-on
On a length around off, Kohli goes back and whips it through midwicket
Tossed up slow and wide of off, Kohli chips it back to the bowler's left
Full outside off, slapped down the ground to long-on
bowls a cutter away from Jacks' swing across the line, he mistimes it to mid-on and scampers aross for a single. A direct hit at the bowler's end and he may have been in trouble.
whips this down to long-on
slower ball into the pitch on a length, Kohli hits this straight to cover
lofted downtown for six! Right into Kohli's hitting arc as Natarajan overpitches, Kohli decided to take on the big boundary down the ground and got enough elevation to clear this.
looks to stay besides the line and flay this through cover but is denied room, he mistimes the drive to mid-off
short of length on middle and leg, tucks it to short fine as they scamper a single
lucky to get away with that! Plays the slog sweep and gets a thickish inside edge to short fine leg.
punched to sweeper cover
drifts in, there's some slow turn that squares Kohli up a hint as he defends back
slaps it straight to point
heaved across the line to deep midwicket
tossed up on off, defended back
driven straight to sweeper cover, Jacks is off the mark

there's Faf out trying to sustain RCB's powerplay salvo! Looks to slap this over cover but this delivery gets big on him, which means he can't generate much power on the shot as Markram takes a simple catch at mid-off. Nattu did well to bowl this into the pitch again.
bowls a slower ball into the pitch, Faf sees width and looks to slap it over cover, but mistimes it to the fielder
drilled down the ground, Nattu instinctively puts his boot out to deflect that to mid-off. Four runs saved
gently dabs it behind square on the off side for a quick single
whips him imperiously to bisect midwicket and mid-on! Kohli is all wrists that time.
Another short-ish ball pulled behind square leg. Natarajan makes the stop but RCB get two more

Good work at the deep backward square boundary! Slower ball on a short length, du Plessis waits and rolls his wrists as he pulls. It was straight of Natarajan and he ran a long way to stop the boundary
Now Faf du Plessis welcomes Cummins with the first six of the match! Length ball around off and Faf gets inside the line and scoops it behind very fine on the leg side for a six
Full on the pads and Kohli clips it past the midwicket fielder for a single
And now he goes inside out! Cummins goes outside off and Kohli lofts it over cover
What glorious wristwork! Cummins bowls it on a length and angles it into Kohli. Kohli takes a step forward and flicks it over midwicket
Crashed through covers! This is full outside off and du Plessis places it wide of the cover fielder
Du Plessis played that a bit wayward, but he won't mind the outcome. Full outside off, he looks to flick it and it comes off the inside half and over the midwicket fielder
On a length around off, Kohli takes a step forward and plays a square drive to deep point
136kph length ball seams in from outside off, du Plessis blocks it out
On a length just outside off, du Plessis punches it towards mid-off and takes off for the single
Back of length outside off, and du Plessis stands tall and punches it past a diving cover fielder. Mid-off and cover point gave chase, but this is a quick outfield and it runs away for four
Low full toss on leg, clipped away past midwicket and straight of deep midwicket. They pick up a brace
Driven to the left of the bowler who can't hold on and they get the single
Kohli wants to take the attack to SRH! Dropped short-ish and Kohli rocks back and pulls it away, but there's a deep midwicket fielder and he will just get one
Faf eases a full delivery wide of long-off to get off the mark
Tossed up outside of, Kohli leans into it and drives it out to long-off
It's a juicy overpitched delivery drifting into his pads and Kohli welcomes that with a little clip behind square leg
Full outside off, driven to cover and that seals the win for RCB
Full outside off, Shahbaz drives it in the air but it lands short of Kohli at long-off
Back of length outside off, slower ball, cut towards point
Full outside off, looks to go inside out and drives it in the air and just wide of du Plessis at extra cover. They get two
Now Dayal bowls a leg-side wide as Shahbaz goes across and looks to flick
Tries to go full and wide and nearly misses the pitch! Given a wide, but they are checking for a no ball! Nope, landed inside the pitch. Just given wide.
Slower bouncer outside off, Shahbaz pulls out of the shot. No wide given. Shahbaz doesn't review it. Phew
Full around off, drilled down the ground to long-off
Another brilliant yorker on leg and Unadkat is able to dig it back out to the bowler. Siraj finishes his spell having conceded just 20 today. He'll be happy with that
Slower short ball across Shahbaz who pulls it away to deep midwicket
Yorker around leg, Unadkat looks to flick it away but misses and it goes off his boot to the leg side

Short ball angled across Unadkat who misses his pull. Called wide and RCB review it. Ball is well above Unadkat's helmet, so the decision will stand. They check for a catch as well, but no contact with the bat. So after all that, we just have a wide
Siraj nails the yorker just outside leg as Unadkat moves leg-side and tries to squeeze it out. Can't get bat on ball though
Low full toss outside off, pushed out to long-off
Back of length outside off, Shahbaz cuts it on the bounce to deep point. Turns down the single
Back of length delivery outside off, Unadkat pulls it high in front of deep midwicket. They manage two as a wayward throw comes in at the striker's end
Top-edge goes for four down fine leg. Unadkat looks to make room and Ferguson follows him with a short ball. He has a swing and gets the top edge
Full and wide, he slices it up as he looks to drive but it lands short of mid-off
Miscues the pull towards deep midwicket and they manage to run two

Will Jacks with some excellent fielding in the deep. Shahbaz goes for the pull again and it just drops on Jacks running to his right. Slides in front of the ball to stop the boundary, with the ball falling inches short
Dug into the pitch on leg, Shahbaz hangs back and nails the pull over deep midwicket
Low full toss punched straight back to Siraj who immediately shapes to throw it at the striker's end but gives the batter a thumbs up after seeing that Unadkat hadn't moved out of his crease
Good wide yorker, all Shahbaz can do is squeeze it out to deep cover
Full ball slapped to cover
Yorker around leg goes through past the leg stump as Unadkat exposes his stumps and looks to drive through the line
Short on leg, Shahbaz swivels and pulls and gets a top edge that lands in no man's land short of deep midwicket
Length ball on off, going across Shahbaz, who slaps it to cover's right
Full on off, punched out to mid-off past the bowler

Chipped to midwicket and Green has his second! Green looks for the yorker and it ends up as a low full toss around leg. Bhuvneshwar looks to work it leg side but ends up hitting it to Siraj, who grabs on at head height
Dug in short, takes him by surprise as he jumps and fends at it. The ball pops up off the shoulder of the bat and drops short of backward point
This was more intentional from Bhuvneshwar Kumar. Short ball angled into him and he just manages to help it along fine
Bhuvneshwar Kumar gets a thick outside edge but it goes wide of the keeper and there is no slip fielder. He'll take the boundary. This was a full delivery outside off
Length ball outside off, cut away to the deep point
flatter one on the stumps, defended back
beaten as Karn tosses it up outside Bhuvi's hitting arc
swung across the line as he gets to the pitch of the ball, a couple of bounces into the deep midwicket fence
nudged into the leg side
dropped by Green at slip! Bhuvi throws the kitchen sink at this tossed up delivery, gets a thick edge. Green put his right hand out to stop the ball, didn't stick
beaten as he heaves across the line. RCB ask for a review just to see if there may have been a faint inside edge. There is none.
swept to deep square
beaten by one that nips away off the seam. Loose drive from Bhuvi.
tucked around into the leg side to short fine
eased down to long-on
excellent bouncer that has Bhuvi into a tangle as he bails out of a pull. The ball lobbed off his glove but fell short of a diving Dinesh Karthik
driven to short cover where Swapnil dives across to stop a single

excellent catch from Siraj at short third! Green bowls a good bumper and bumps out his Australian captain. Goes short, wide and Cummins has no pace on it as he tries to help it over, but ends up spooning it high in the air as Siraj running back takes it nice and easy.
starts with a wide as it's way over Cummins
flicked to deep square as Dayal bowls yorker-length on leg-stump
another excellent slower bouncer that Cummins tries to pull but is beaten as he's way too early into it
swing and a miss. Cummins' bottom hand comes off the bat handle as he swings across the line
steers this low full toss to deep point
bottom-edges a drive on the bounce to DK, who half-stops, they get a single
slower ball into the pitch on middle-stump, pulled to deep midwicket
heaved into the leg side, excellent work by Lomror running around the ropes at deep square
belts this flat to long-off
tucked into the leg side
can't drop short at this level! This is poor from Karn. Sat up for Cummins to rock back and muscle this pull to clear deep midwicket
helped around the corner over short fine. Karn strays down leg, Cummins did well to get inside the line and pick it over.
toe-ends this sweep to deep midwicket
make that two in two! Serves up a nice hit-me slotball as Cummins swings him down the ground to clear wide long-on. Into the second tier.
just over Green's outstretched hands at deep midwicket! Half-tracker that Cummins absolutely hammers as he rocks back and pulls. Would've been a stunning take had that stuck
heaves this high full toss to deep midwicket
eased down to long-off as they jog the single
pushed through quicker on middle and leg, eased down to long-on
sees Shahbaz advancing and fires this across, dabbed to short third
cut away to deep point
tossed up on off-stump, pushed back to the bowler
flat-bats this down the ground, stunning work by Jacks who comes up with a diving stop running across from mid-on
works this wide of the man coming in from deep square
drifts one in from wide of the crease, the ball fizzes away sharply as Cummins leaves

chipped back to Karn! Samad steps out and has to readjust because Karn flattens his trajectory and gets this to bite off the deck, he attempts a nudge down the ground but ends up lobbing it back as Karn dives to his right to take an excellent catch.
punched to deep point
swivels around and pulls this slower delivery down to deep backward square leg
short ball and outside leg, Shahbaz swivels around and uses his pace to help it down to the fine leg boundary
excellent bumper on leg-stump at 146.2kph, Shahbaz ducks under this
digs in a short ball on middle, Samad flat-bats this past the bowler
greets him with a swat over long-on! Stand and deliver stuff. Sat up for Samad to wallop that across the line.
wrong'un on a length outside off, defended into the leg side
shortish on middle and leg, tucked to deep square
skids one across Shahbaz on a length, pushed to long-off
works this googly to long-on

knocked him over! Nitish attempts to reverse sweep that over point but is caught into a tangle as this one zips off the pitch, sips away and flattens the off stump. A delivery every legspinner dreams of bowling.
slips this quicker one down leg, wide called as Nitish attempts a pull
starts with a sharp legbreak on a length around middle and leg, Nitish gets a leading edge that rolls into the off side
bunts this to wide long-on
lucky to get away with that short and wide delivery, Shahbaz mistimes the cut to point for a single. May have damaged the bottom of his bat in doing so.
drifts into middle and leg, nudged around towards deep midwicket
flatter one on middle and leg, tucked to square leg
wrists this down to deep midwicket
punched to long-on
Slower short ball on leg, pulled away on the bounce to deep square leg
Very full on the stumps, dug out through midwicket
Full on off at 140kph, he clips it to mid-on and takes off for a quick single. The throw is quick at the non-striker's end but the batter makes it in safely as the throw goes wide
Length ball tapped to cover
Sways away from a bouncer
Low full toss around off, Nitish clips it wide of deep midwicket

And Klaasen goes for another big shot but only skies it to mid-on! Swapnil Singh is absolutely pumped! That's a huge wicket! Swapnil pulls his length back just enough and the ball spins away as Klaasen goes after it. The ball balloons high in the air and with Cameron Green under it, there was very little chance of it being dropped. And SRH are four down! Double-wicket over is not a bad way to start your IPL bowling career! Especially if you account for Klaasen!
You don't bowl slot balls to Heinrich Klaasen! You just don't! Stands still, waits on it, and swings through the line over long-on!

On a length outside off, punched to long-off and there's a run-out chance! Kohli fumbled at long-off, and Nitish wanted a second but was sent back. Nitish was some ways down the crease when he realised he had to turn back and put in the dive. By the time Swapnil collected the ball and threw it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end, Nitish Kumar Reddy had his bat in thanks to his dive
Floats up a full toss quite wide of off. Lets Nitish stretch his arms and smack it down the ground for a six!
Darts it on a length on off, Klaasen punches it out to long-off. And wait, he has overstepped! Free hit coming up

That is some way to make your RCB debut! Markram steps out and misses a full toss and is hit on his back thigh. Finger goes up immediately and Markram is quick to review. No bat involved. Impact seems to have been just in front of off - it could be umpire's call. But we wait for ball tracking. Impact in line and that was dropping to hit the base of leg stump. Swapnil Singh, hit for a four first ball, gets the big wicket of Markram next. Kohli can't hold back his laughter as du Plessis takes Swapnil aside for some instructions. He won't mind how it's come, he'll be elated he got that wicket!
Starts with a length ball outside off and Markram backs away and cuts it past the diving point fielder for a boundary

That would be hard to call that a chance, but that was hit straight back at Dayal! Length ball on leg, slapped flat and hard right back at Dayal who manages to get his hands down to the ball at waist-height, but it came on too quickly to him
Length ball on middle at 137kph, Nitish blocks

Goes straight up in the air and that's easy as it comes for Dinesh Karthik! Abhishek Sharma looked to pull away a length delivery and ends up slicing it high in the air. Karthik settled under it early and watched it all the way into his gloves. That's the two openers gone inside four overs! Do RCB have an opening?
Full and wide, but just past the tramline. Umpire has his arms up
That's a high full toss, Abhishek swings it away and it falls wide of the deep midwicket fielder running to his right and goes for four

Great drive, great fielding! Full around off and Markram meets it with a firm push past the non-striker. But Kohli runs to his right from mid-off and throws himself at the ball to save it from going away for four
Length ball on middle, punched to mid-off. They don't risk a single
Dragged down and hammered away! Abhishek Sharma levels with Klaasen for most sixes this season as he rocks back and pulls a half-tracker away over midwicket
Jacks fizzes it in on a length outside off, Markram skips out and clips it to long-on
Full around off, pushed out towards long-on for a single
Skips out and goes for a big swing again but gets it off the inside edge through square leg
No doubt about that one clearing the rope! Jumps down the track as Jacks goes full on middle and hammers it over long-on and into the stands. 100th six for SRH in IPL 2024!
Abhishek Sharma is not holding back any more. This is tossed up full outside off and Abhishek goes inside out over cover and it just drops short of the boundary rope
Length ball on off at 140.4kph, Markram can only parry it leg side. Just 11 runs off the first two overs!
Yorker just outside off, driven out wide of mid-on
Dug in short, Abhishek goes for the pull but miscues it. But there's no one in the deep midwicket area so it's a safe shot. That came off close to the toe end of the bat
Bouncer on leg, sails over Abhishek. Wide called immediately
Chipped in the air, but in the gap. Length ball holds up, Markram looks to drive on the up and it goes uppishly between cover and lands short of mid-off moving to his left
Full delivery around off, Markram jams his bat down to keep it out
Yorker on off and Abhishek is able to dig it out wide of mid-on for a single

The plan works for RCB!  The big wicket of Travis Head! Head goes for the big shot, but it spins away so he is completely out of shape. Takes a top edge and pops up fine on the off side and Karn Sharma makes no mistake!
Angles in another length ball and Abhishek pushes it out to mid-off for a quick single
Abhishek punches a length ball to cover
Tossed full on leg, Head clips it out through midwicket
On a length on off, angling in. Head pushes it out to mid-off
Jacks starts with a length ball that Abhishek eases towards point for a single to get off the mark
